scripts.text: - You may proceed after reaching level 145 or over -
scripts.translation: - 达到145级或以上后即可继续 -

scripts.text: I would say I am Professor Bernhard, the best weapons researcher in Schwarzwald.
scripts.translation: 我是伯恩哈德教授，舒茨瓦尔德最优秀的武器研究者。

scripts.text: After endless research I have created various weapons, but I felt something was missing so I found the ancient texts.
scripts.translation: 经过无数次研究，我制作了各种武器，但总觉得还缺了些什么，于是找到了古代文献。

scripts.text: I found out about the Dimensional Device during my research.
scripts.translation: 我在研究中得知了次元装置。

scripts.text: I also realized that relics from the glorious past were also needed to create more powerful and superior weapons.
scripts.translation: 我还发现，要制造更强大、更优秀的武器，也需要来自辉煌过去的遗物。

scripts.text: A longing for accomplishing a powerful weapon as a genuine professor!
scripts.translation: 作为一名真正的教授，我渴望完成一件强大的武器！

scripts.text: In order to accomplish that, we need shards of Gigantes that once appeared in the past battle of Fenrir and Sarah.
scripts.translation: 为此，我们需要曾在芬里尔与莎拉过去的战斗中出现的巨人碎片。

scripts.text: I need a warrior who can bring me the shards instead..
scripts.translation: 所以我需要一位能替我取回碎片的战士..

scripts.text: I will continue discussing this further with your party leader rather than with you.
scripts.translation: 我会和你的队长继续商谈，不再和你讨论。

scripts.text: I need a warrior who can bring me the shard of Gigantes instead..
scripts.translation: 所以我需要一位能替我取回巨人碎片的战士..

scripts.text: Would you go to the past and bring me back the shards of Gigantes?
scripts.translation: 你愿意回到过去，替我带回巨人碎片吗？

scripts.text: I will make sure to compensate you sufficiently.
scripts.translation: 我一定会给你丰厚的报酬。

scripts.text: Visit me again if you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 改变主意的话，再来找我。

scripts.text: I set the Dimensional Device to Glast Heim of the past, where Fenrir and Sarah once fought.
scripts.translation: 我已将次元装置设定到过去的古城，也就是芬里尔和莎拉曾经战斗的地方。

scripts.text: The operating time isn't long so hurry up and come back.
scripts.translation: 装置维持不了太久，快去快回。

scripts.text: Did you successfully bring back the shards of Gigantes?
scripts.translation: 你成功带回巨人碎片了吗？

scripts.text: You probably faced a lot of danger so thank you for the effort.
scripts.translation: 你一定经历了许多危险，辛苦了。

scripts.text: I don't expect to receive the shards for nothing when you have risked your life for them!
scripts.translation: 你冒着生命危险带回碎片，我当然不会白白收下！

scripts.text: I will give you a useful looking earring from the relics I have happened to have obtained during my previous research.
scripts.translation: 我会把之前研究时偶然得到的一件遗物耳饰送给你，应该能派上用场。

scripts.text: If you hand the shards of Gigantes to my chief assistant, I will make sure the earrings will be correspondingly great through an enchantment.
scripts.translation: 把巨人碎片交给我的首席助手后，他会为耳饰附魔，让它们变得更加强大。

scripts.text: The more shards of Gigantes are collected, the better.
scripts.translation: 巨人碎片收集得越多越好。

scripts.text: However, there isn't a stable supply of energy needed to work the Dimensional Device.
scripts.translation: 不过，目前没有足够稳定的能源来驱动次元装置。

scripts.text: Come back and find me after one week has passed for the supply of Dimensional Device energy.
scripts.translation: 一周后再来找我，届时次元装置的能源应该就补充好了。

scripts.text: I need you to find shards of Gigantes again.
scripts.translation: 我需要你再次去寻找巨人碎片。

scripts.text: We lack the shards of Gigantes in order to make powerful weapons.
scripts.translation: 我们缺少制造强大武器所需的巨人碎片。

scripts.text: Because a lot of energy is needed to open a dimension device, come back and find me when the energy has accumulated.
scripts.translation: 启动次元装置需要大量能源，等能源积蓄好后再来找我。

scripts.text: While you were gone I have succeeded in accumulating dimensional energy.
scripts.translation: 你离开期间，我成功积蓄了次元能源。

scripts.text: We can open the dimension device again.
scripts.translation: 我们可以再次启动次元装置了。

scripts.text: A longing for accomplishing a powerful weapon as a genuine professor!
scripts.translation: 作为一名真正的教授，我渴望完成一件强大的武器！

scripts.text: In order to accomplish that, we need shards of Gigantes that once appeared in the past battle of Fenrir and Sarah.
scripts.translation: 为此，我们需要曾在芬里尔与莎拉过去的战斗中出现的巨人碎片。

scripts.text: Because I cannot leave my post,
I need a warrior who can bring me the shards instead.
scripts.translation: 所以我需要一位能替我取回碎片的战士。

scripts.text: I think you can assist me once again..
scripts.translation: 我想你可以再帮我一次..

scripts.text: There, all the preparations are finished.
scripts.translation: 好了，准备工作都完成了。

scripts.text: Can you go back in time again and bring me the shards of Gigantes?
scripts.translation: 你能再次回到过去，替我带回巨人碎片吗？

scripts.text: I will make sure to compensate you sufficiently.
scripts.translation: 我一定会给你丰厚的报酬。

scripts.text: I set the Dimensional Device to Glast Heim of the past, where Fenrir and Sarah once were.
scripts.translation: 我已将次元装置设定到过去的古城，也就是芬里尔和莎拉曾经所在的地方。

scripts.text: It won't last long so hurry up and come back.
scripts.translation: 装置维持不了太久，快去快回。

scripts.text: - You must be level 145 or over
It seems entry is not possible. -
It seems entry is not possible. -
The party leader has not created the Memorial Dungeon.
scripts.translation: 队长尚未创建纪念碑副本。

scripts.text: Only party members can enter the Memorial Dungeon.
scripts.translation: 只有队伍成员才能进入此记忆副本。

scripts.text: I've heard about you from the professor.
The professor has told me to sufficiently compensate you for risking your life and bringing the shards of Gigantes.
scripts.translation: 教授让我好好酬谢你，感谢你冒着生命危险带回巨人碎片。

scripts.text: Sarah's earrings we have discovered at the archaeological site must certainly have great potential.
scripts.translation: 我们在遗迹中发现的莎拉耳饰，肯定蕴藏着巨大的潜能。

scripts.text: 2 enchantments are possible on one earring.
scripts.translation: 每只耳饰最多可以附魔两次。

scripts.text: Which earring do you wish to enchant?
You must equip the item to make enchantment possible.
scripts.translation: 必须装备该物品才能进行附魔。

scripts.text: Which column do you wish to enchant?
If you wish to enchant, you must equip Sarah's {0} earring.
scripts.translation: 要进行附魔，必须装备莎拉的{0}耳饰。

scripts.text: A fully enchanted earring of Sarah cannot be enchanted any further.
scripts.translation: 莎拉的耳饰已附满魔，无法继续附魔。

scripts.text: Sarah's Earring is currently in a state of enchantment in slot 4.
scripts.translation: 莎拉耳饰的第4栏当前已附魔。

scripts.text: Sarah's Earring is currently in a state without enchantment.
scripts.translation: 莎拉耳饰当前尚未附魔。

scripts.text: Which ability do you want as an enchantment on slot {0}?
scripts.translation: 你想为第{0}栏附加哪种能力？

scripts.text: Selected for CRI or Critical Enchantment slot {0}.
scripts.translation: 已选择为第{0}栏附加CRI或暴击类附魔。

scripts.text: Selected for Expert Archer or Bleed Enchantment slot {0}.
scripts.translation: 已选择为第{0}栏附加神射手或出血类附魔。

scripts.text: Selected for Conservation or MATK Enchantment slot {0}.
scripts.translation: 已选择为第{0}栏附加魔力节约或MATK类附魔。

scripts.text: Selected for Delay Attack or Delay Skill Enchantment slot {0}.
scripts.translation: 已选择为第{0}栏附加攻击延迟或技能延迟类附魔。

scripts.text: 4 shards of Gigantes is required for one enchantment.
scripts.translation: 每次附魔需要4个巨人碎片。

scripts.text: Because enchantment is a high risk process, there is risk of Sarah's earring being destroyed.
scripts.translation: 附魔存在很高风险，莎拉耳饰有可能被摧毁。

scripts.text: Do you still want to do it?
Please speak to me again after making a clear decision!
There are not enough shards of Gigantes.
4 shards of Gigantes is required to do one enchantment.
scripts.translation: 进行一次附魔需要4个巨人碎片。

scripts.text: Good. I will start the enchantment!
enchantment is not an easy task..
scripts.translation: 附魔可不是什么轻松的事..

scripts.text: Which earring do you wish to initialize?
If you want to initialize an enchantment on Sarah's earrings, come and find me again.
scripts.translation: 想初始化莎拉耳饰上的附魔，请再来找我。

scripts.text: On Sarah's earring. 1 shard of Gigantes is required to initialize the enchantment..
scripts.translation: 初始化莎拉耳饰的附魔需要1个巨人碎片..

scripts.text: There are not enough shards of Gigantes.
You will need them in order for initialization to take place.
scripts.translation: 需要准备好材料才能进行初始化。

scripts.text: You must equip the item to make initialization possible.
scripts.translation: 必须装备该物品才能进行初始化。

scripts.text: Which column's earring do you wish to initialize?
scripts.translation: 你想初始化哪个栏位的耳饰？

scripts.text: To initialize an enchantment, the relevant column must be equipped with gear.
scripts.translation: 要初始化附魔，必须在对应栏位装备物品。

scripts.text: To initialize an enchantment, the relevant column must be equipped with Sarah's earring.
scripts.translation: 要初始化附魔，必须在对应栏位装备莎拉耳饰。

scripts.text: Sarah's earring without an enchantment cannot be initialized.
scripts.translation: 没有附魔的莎拉耳饰无法初始化。

scripts.text: You have selected Sarah's {0} earring on the {1} column.
scripts.translation: 你选择了莎拉的{0}耳饰，位于第{1}栏。

scripts.text: It is impossible to restore abilities that are gone after initialization.
scripts.translation: 初始化后，已经消失的能力无法恢复。

scripts.text: Do you still want to proceed?
Please find me if you need me.
If you want an enchantment on Sarah's earrings, come and find me again.
scripts.translation: 想为莎拉的耳饰附魔的话，请再来找我。

scripts.text: Related to Glast Heim, this is an unique and rare earring found during an excavation with the professor.
scripts.translation: 这是教授在古城遗迹发掘时发现的独特而稀有的耳饰。

scripts.text: I think this has been worn by Sarah in the past and seems to have a great ability to draw out potential strength.
scripts.translation: 我想它过去是莎拉佩戴的，似乎能充分发挥佩戴者的潜力。

scripts.text: I will specially trade it for 1 shard since you are the warrior who brought shards of Gigantes for the professor's work.
scripts.translation: 你为教授带回了巨人碎片，是位出色的战士，所以我特别用1个碎片和你交换。

scripts.text: There are not enough shards of Gigantes.
You will need them for me to trade with you.
scripts.translation: 准备好材料后我才能和你交换。

scripts.text: Professor Bernhard is the professor I respect the most.
scripts.translation: 伯恩哈德教授是我最敬重的教授。

scripts.text: Do you have someone you respect?
I've heard about you from the professor.
The professor has told me to sufficiently compensate you for risking your life and bringing the shards of Gigantes.
scripts.translation: 教授让我好好酬谢你，感谢你冒着生命危险带回巨人碎片。

scripts.text: It was difficult and dangerous work
scripts.translation: 这项工作既困难又危险，

scripts.text: so I am grateful for your help.
I feel we will meet again
but perhaps it is just my imagination?
so I hope we will meet again.
harm can come your way as well.
so I hope we will meet again.
